[[File:Nubswood.png|thumb|right|250px|An engagement taking place in Nubswood.]]
{{Quote|Deep, dark forest. Popular hideout for thieves.|Description}}
The '''Nubswood''' {{J|ヌーベスの森|Nūbesu no mori}} is a deep, dark forest from ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It can be freed after "Mission #006: Antilaws" and "Mission #070: Raven's Oath" are completed.

==Missions==
*"Mission #003: The Cheetahs"
{{Quote|There's a price on the heads of the band of conmen calling themselves the "Cheetahs." Word is they were seen in the Nubswood!|Bratt, Streetear}}
*"Mission #025: Wanted!"
{{Quote|This Month's Wanted! Black Mage Dolce: 4600 gil<br/>Dangerous magic use<br/>Eating and running<br/>Assorted misdemeanors<br/>Last spotted in forest}}
*"Mission #071: Nubswood Base"
{{Quote|We've discovered a Borzoi Base in the Nubswood. Help us root this evil out of our lands forever!|Sprohm Town Watch}}
*"Mission #086: Last Stand"
{{Quote|I sense... a life-force possessing unfathomable magic powers! It would be folly to let it roam wild. Kill it! Kill it!|Shaton, Diviner}}
*"Mission #242: The Nubswood"
{{Quote|Rock turtles have been attacking travelers in the Nubswood. Use this "shellout" to get rid of them, please.|Hoelik, Townsperson}}

==Encounters==
===Rangers===
{{Quote|Preservationists. Radical clan that doesn't like others coming into the woods.|Description}}
Members:
*[[White Mage (Tactics Advance)|White Mage]] (Viera)
*[[Animist (Tactics Advance)|Animist]] (Moogle)
*[[Elementalist (Tactics Advance)|Elementalist]] (Viera)
*[[Archer (Tactics Advance)|Archer]] (Viera)
*[[Fencer (Tactics Advance)|Fencer]] (Viera)
This clan will only stay in their territory and not move to other areas, befitting their preservationist status.

==Turf Defense==
===Help Nubs!===
{{Quote|Rockbeasts are nesting in the Nubswood. If they move in for good, we're finished! I hope Clan [Nutsy] can help us!|Town rumor}}
*[[Beastmaster (Tactics Advance)|Beastmaster]]
*[[Blade Biter (Tactics Advance)|Blade Biter]]
*[[Toughskin (Tactics Advance)|Toughskin]] x2
